module Splice.Scripts.TestAmuletConversionRateFeed where

import DA.Assert
import DA.Time
import Daml.Script

import Splice.Ans.AmuletConversionRateFeed
import Splice.Api.FeaturedAppRightV1 qualified as Api
import Splice.Scripts.Util
import Splice.Util

checkRate : Party -> ContractId AmuletConversionRateFeed -> Decimal -> Script ()
checkRate p cid expectedRate = do
  Some feed <- queryContractId p cid
  require ("actual rate " <> show feed.amuletConversionRate <> " should be expected rate " <> show expectedRate) (feed.amuletConversionRate == expectedRate)

-- Note: SVs can run automation that observes these contracts and then based on that exercises `DsoRules_UpdateAmuletPriceVote`.
-- There is deliberately no on-ledger coupling that e.g. would fetch the conversion rate feed in the same transaction that updates the price as:
-- 1. There is no reason to enforce this. SVs deliberately have free choice in the price they set.
-- 2. On-ledger coupling is much less flexible when it comes to different policies, e.g., voting on the median of multiple feeds.
-- However, the feeds are visible to the DSO party visible so anyone can verify how the vote from an SV relate to a given feed.
testAmuletConversionRateFeed : Script ()
testAmuletConversionRateFeed = do
  app <- setupApp
  publisherUser <- setupValidator' app "publisher"
  let publisher = publisherUser.primaryParty
  featuredAppRightCid <- featureApp app publisherUser
  cid <- submit publisher $ createCmd AmuletConversionRateFeed with
    publisher
    dso = app.dso
    nextUpdateAfter = None
    amuletConversionRate = 1.0

  checkRate app.dso cid 1.0

  (amuletRulesCid, _) <- getAmuletRules app

  now <- getTime

  AmuletConversionRateFeed_UpdateResult cid <- submitMulti [publisher] [app.dso] $ exerciseCmd cid AmuletConversionRateFeed_Update with
    amuletConversionRate = 2.0
    amuletRulesCid
    markerContextO = None
    newNextUpdateAfter = now `addRelTime` minutes 5

  checkRate app.dso cid 2.0

  -- fails due to rate limit, as now < nextUpdateAfter
  submitMultiMustFail [publisher] [app.dso] $ exerciseCmd cid AmuletConversionRateFeed_Update with
    amuletConversionRate = 2.0
    amuletRulesCid
    markerContextO = None
    newNextUpdateAfter = now `addRelTime` minutes 10

  passTime (minutes 5)

  now <- getTime

  -- fails as newNextUpdateAfter is not > now + 5 minutes
  submitMultiMustFail [publisher] [app.dso] $ exerciseCmd cid AmuletConversionRateFeed_Update with
    amuletConversionRate = 4.0
    amuletRulesCid
    markerContextO = Some MarkerContext with
      beneficiaries = [Api.AppRewardBeneficiary publisher 1.0]
      featuredAppRightCid = toInterfaceContractId featuredAppRightCid
    newNextUpdateAfter = now `addRelTime` minutes 4

  -- succeeds if newNextUpdateAfter = now + 5 minutes
  AmuletConversionRateFeed_UpdateResult cid <- submitMulti [publisher] [app.dso] $ exerciseCmd cid AmuletConversionRateFeed_Update with
    amuletConversionRate = 4.0
    amuletRulesCid
    markerContextO = Some MarkerContext with
      beneficiaries = [Api.AppRewardBeneficiary publisher 1.0]
      featuredAppRightCid = toInterfaceContractId featuredAppRightCid
    newNextUpdateAfter = now `addRelTime` minutes 5

  checkRate app.dso cid 4.0

  markers <- queryInterface @Api.FeaturedAppActivityMarker publisher
  length markers === 1

  pure ()

module Splice.Scripts.TestAmuletConversionRateFeed where

import DA.Assert
import DA.Time
import Daml.Script

import Splice.Amulet (FeaturedAppRight(..), FeaturedAppActivityMarker(..))
import Splice.AmuletRules
import Splice.Ans.AmuletConversionRateFeed
import qualified Splice.Api.FeaturedAppRightV1 as Api
import Splice.Scripts.Util (setupApp)

testUpdateTimingAndState : Script ()
testUpdateTimingAndState = script do
  app <- setupApp
  publisher <- allocateParty "publisher"
  [(rulesCid, _)] <- query @AmuletRules app.dso
  now <- getTime
  feedCid <- submit publisher $ createCmd AmuletConversionRateFeed with
    publisher
    dso = app.dso
    nextUpdateAfter = None
    amuletConversionRate = 1.0

  submitMultiMustFail [publisher] [app.dso] $ exerciseCmd feedCid AmuletConversionRateFeed_Update with
    amuletConversionRate = 2.0
    amuletRulesCid = rulesCid
    markerContextO = None
    newNextUpdateAfter = addRelTime now (minutes 5 - microseconds 1)

  result <- submitMulti [publisher] [app.dso] $ exerciseCmd feedCid AmuletConversionRateFeed_Update with
    amuletConversionRate = 2.0
    amuletRulesCid = rulesCid
    markerContextO = None
    newNextUpdateAfter = addRelTime now (minutes 5)
  Some updated <- queryContractId publisher result.cid
  updated.publisher === publisher
  updated.dso === app.dso
  updated.amuletConversionRate === 2.0
  updated.nextUpdateAfter === Some (addRelTime now (minutes 5))
  None <- queryContractId publisher feedCid

  submitMultiMustFail [publisher] [app.dso] $ exerciseCmd result.cid AmuletConversionRateFeed_Update with
    amuletConversionRate = 3.0
    amuletRulesCid = rulesCid
    markerContextO = None
    newNextUpdateAfter = addRelTime now (minutes 10)
  passTime (minutes 5 + microseconds 1)
  later <- getTime
  result2 <- submitMulti [publisher] [app.dso] $ exerciseCmd result.cid AmuletConversionRateFeed_Update with
    amuletConversionRate = 3.0
    amuletRulesCid = rulesCid
    markerContextO = None
    newNextUpdateAfter = addRelTime later (minutes 6)
  Some updatedAgain <- queryContractId publisher result2.cid
  updatedAgain.amuletConversionRate === 3.0
  updatedAgain.nextUpdateAfter === Some (addRelTime later (minutes 6))
  None <- queryContractId publisher result.cid
  pure ()

testRulesAndControllers : Script ()
testRulesAndControllers = script do
  app <- setupApp
  publisher <- allocateParty "publisher"
  otherDso <- allocateParty "other-dso"
  [(rulesCid, rules)] <- query @AmuletRules app.dso
  otherRulesCid <- submit otherDso $ createCmd AmuletRules with
    dso = otherDso
    configSchedule = rules.configSchedule
    isDevNet = True
  now <- getTime
  feedCid <- submit publisher $ createCmd AmuletConversionRateFeed with
    publisher
    dso = app.dso
    nextUpdateAfter = None
    amuletConversionRate = 1.0
  submitMustFail app.dso $ exerciseCmd feedCid AmuletConversionRateFeed_Update with
    amuletConversionRate = 2.0
    amuletRulesCid = rulesCid
    markerContextO = None
    newNextUpdateAfter = addRelTime now (minutes 5)
  submitMultiMustFail [publisher] [app.dso, otherDso] $ exerciseCmd feedCid AmuletConversionRateFeed_Update with
    amuletConversionRate = 2.0
    amuletRulesCid = otherRulesCid
    markerContextO = None
    newNextUpdateAfter = addRelTime now (minutes 5)
  submitMustFail publisher $ exerciseCmd feedCid AmuletConversionRateFeed_ArchiveAsDso with reason = "not dso"
  Some original <- queryContractId publisher feedCid
  original.amuletConversionRate === 1.0
  _ <- submit app.dso $ exerciseCmd feedCid AmuletConversionRateFeed_ArchiveAsDso with reason = "retired"
  None <- queryContractId publisher feedCid
  pure ()

testActivityMarkers : Script ()
testActivityMarkers = script do
  app <- setupApp
  publisher <- allocateParty "publisher"
  otherPublisher <- allocateParty "other-publisher"
  otherDso <- allocateParty "other-dso"
  [(rulesCid, _)] <- query @AmuletRules app.dso
  rightCid <- submit app.dso $ createCmd FeaturedAppRight with dso = app.dso; provider = publisher
  wrongOwnerCid <- submit app.dso $ createCmd FeaturedAppRight with dso = app.dso; provider = otherPublisher
  wrongDsoCid <- submit otherDso $ createCmd FeaturedAppRight with dso = otherDso; provider = publisher
  now <- getTime
  feedCid <- submit publisher $ createCmd AmuletConversionRateFeed with
    publisher
    dso = app.dso
    nextUpdateAfter = None
    amuletConversionRate = 1.0
  let beneficiaries = [Api.AppRewardBeneficiary publisher 0.4, Api.AppRewardBeneficiary otherPublisher 0.6]
  let updateWith right = AmuletConversionRateFeed_Update with
        amuletConversionRate = 1.5
        amuletRulesCid = rulesCid
        markerContextO = Some (MarkerContext (toInterfaceContractId @Api.FeaturedAppRight right) beneficiaries)
        newNextUpdateAfter = addRelTime now (minutes 5)
  submitMultiMustFail [publisher] [app.dso] $ exerciseCmd feedCid (updateWith wrongOwnerCid)
  submitMultiMustFail [publisher] [app.dso, otherDso] $ exerciseCmd feedCid (updateWith wrongDsoCid)
  let invalidUpdate = AmuletConversionRateFeed_Update with
        amuletConversionRate = 1.5
        amuletRulesCid = rulesCid
        markerContextO = Some (MarkerContext (toInterfaceContractId @Api.FeaturedAppRight rightCid) [Api.AppRewardBeneficiary publisher 0.4])
        newNextUpdateAfter = addRelTime now (minutes 5)
  submitMultiMustFail [publisher] [app.dso] $ exerciseCmd feedCid invalidUpdate
  [] <- query @FeaturedAppActivityMarker publisher
  result <- submitMulti [publisher] [app.dso] $ exerciseCmd feedCid (updateWith rightCid)
  Some updated <- queryContractId publisher result.cid
  updated.amuletConversionRate === 1.5
  markers <- query @FeaturedAppActivityMarker publisher
  length markers === 2
  let weights = map (\(_, marker) -> (marker.beneficiary, marker.weight)) markers
  assert (elem (publisher, 0.4) weights)
  assert (elem (otherPublisher, 0.6) weights)

testConfiguredTickDuration : Script ()
testConfiguredTickDuration = script do
  app <- setupApp
  publisher <- allocateParty "publisher"
  [(rulesCid, rules)] <- query @AmuletRules app.dso
  longerRulesCid <- submit app.dso $ createCmd AmuletRules with
    dso = app.dso
    isDevNet = True
    configSchedule = rules.configSchedule with
      initialValue = rules.configSchedule.initialValue with tickDuration = minutes 20
  now <- getTime
  feedCid <- submit publisher $ createCmd AmuletConversionRateFeed with
    publisher
    dso = app.dso
    nextUpdateAfter = None
    amuletConversionRate = 1.0
  submitMultiMustFail [publisher] [app.dso] $ exerciseCmd feedCid AmuletConversionRateFeed_Update with
    amuletConversionRate = 2.0
    amuletRulesCid = longerRulesCid
    markerContextO = None
    newNextUpdateAfter = addRelTime now (minutes 5)
  result <- submitMulti [publisher] [app.dso] $ exerciseCmd feedCid AmuletConversionRateFeed_Update with
    amuletConversionRate = 2.0
    amuletRulesCid = longerRulesCid
    markerContextO = None
    newNextUpdateAfter = addRelTime now (minutes 10)
  Some updated <- queryContractId publisher result.cid
  updated.nextUpdateAfter === Some (addRelTime now (minutes 10))
  updated.amuletConversionRate === 2.0
